charts.title: TOI-5143 c: orbits around TOI-5143
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5143's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5143 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Radzom et al. 2025 (2025AJ....169..189R), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname RADZOM_ET_AL__2025): P 5.2097118 d

charts.title: TOI-5143 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5143 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 46, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 281837575, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 7-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
